title: Merge user settings over the defaults
requirement: Implement `merge_settings(base, override)` in `settingskit/merge.py`. It returns the merged settings. A key in `override` wins over the same key in `base`. When both values are dicts, merge them recursively so keys that only `base` holds survive.
invariants: a key only in base survives
a key only in override is added
nested dicts merge key by key
acceptance_criteria: An override value replaces the base value for the same key
A nested override keeps the base keys it does not name
Merging with an empty override returns the base settings

reset.notes: Copy initial/ into an empty directory; delete that directory after grading.

provenance.reason: A merge helper that edits its first argument. The loader passes a shared defaults dict, so the second load sees the first load's overrides.
